item.title: Unveiling Canada’s new $20 bank note - Speech (Webcasts)

rating.summary: Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem participated in a ceremonial event to unveil Canada's new vertical $20 bank note. The speech appears to be a public presentation focused on currency design rather than monetary policy. No monetary policy content is indicated in the available text.
rating.stance_rationale: This is a ceremonial/communications event related to bank note design and has no monetary policy content.
